title: Singular House In A Black Void
content: I had a dream years ago that began with me walking through an outdoors basketball court in the middle of town houses. I then walked into a field, and everyone started floating, flying, and we were all amazed. Then a golden cloud descended from the sky and as it billowed an angelic figure with a bow and arrow was inside. It was a grown white man with blonde hair. He was smiling, and then his smile turned sinister. As we saw this we all tried flying away. He started shooting his arrows at people. I looked back at him, locked eyes, and he shot me. The next thing I know I'm in an endless black space and my perspective is zooming onto this singular house in this endless void. Then my perspective goes into the house and I'm in my body walking around. Inside the house there was a bunch of young people but nobody knew what was going on. A man that I knew was "the devil" told me to come here to the front door, and said look. I looked outside and there was a bunch of old men wearing various religious outfits from the past and present. They looked absolutely miserable and they were walking through this smoke. The devil said "these are all of the noble men of the past, kings, preachers, religious leaders" and "You can go outside with them or stay inside with everyone else". When he said that they all looked up at me and I could see they were so depressed so I said no I want to stay inside. OKAY THIS IS THE PART WHY I MADE THIS POST HERE. When I went back in I went over to the kitchen area and sat on the counter. There was a bunch of younger people like me, like 16 to early twenties, and we all were like "do y'all realize we're dreaming?" And we all said yes! I said "we have to find each other when we wake up" and everybody in the kitchen agreed. We didn't have much time to talk after that cause the devil figure walked back into the house and started taking attendance on his clipboard. He didn't seem overtly evil he just seemed like he was doing his job. More happened after but I'll end it there. EDIT - EXTENSION After he came back in, he started calling people's names for attendance. I wish I could remember some of the names I heard but I don't. We all got scared immediately and tried to hide in the house. I still remember how the house looked vividly. Right by the front door there was a circular wooden table I tried to hide under. He eventually got to me in the roll call and he was aware of where I was. He just walked up to the table, pulled the chair out and sat on it. Kinda like "what do you think you doing?" or "you really thought that would work?“ but it wasn't terrifyingly evil. Then he pulled out a little black book from his back pocket that I already knew was the Bible. He went on to say something along the lines of "You think this is the only truth? Every book has a little bit of truth and you must read them all to see how it connects." I woke up right after this. I'm looking for the original notes I wrote after I had the dream but I haven't found them yet. If I do, I'll post that original dream. TLDR: I had a dream I met a bunch of young people in a kitchen, in a house in an eternal black void, and we said we would find eachother when we wake up!
